_instructions.description: MCP configuration for Stoopid Weather Server
setup_steps: 1. Replace '/absolute/path/to/your/.venv/bin/python' with actual path to Python in your virtual environment
2. Replace '/absolute/path/to/Apps_with_AI/Week09/stoopid_wx_server.py' with actual path to the server script
3. Ensure secrets.env file exists in Week09/ directory with SERPAPI_API_KEY set
4. For Claude Desktop: Add this to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
5. For LM Studio: Add this to LM Studio MCP Server settings
6. Restart the MCP client after configuration

testing.verify_tools: Should show 'get_weather' tool in MCP client
